clips.title: The story
paras: Pumpkins are taken from a human farmstead north of Deathknell for the Royal Apothecary Society in Brill. Deathguard Simmer sends newly risen Forsaken to gather them.

Deathguard Simmer sends you from the crypts of Deathknell into a hostile land. He serves Sylvanas Windrunner's forces, where survival means taking what the living possess and putting it to use for the Undercity's darker aims.

The farm lies west of the road, north of Deathknell, where mortal human peasants work blighted soil. Simmer says they infest the realm like mold on a corpse. The farmers hold their homesteads under the uneasy protection of nearby Scarlet Crusade towers. Taking their crops strikes at their supplies and provides produce for the Royal Apothecary Society's research.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: What have we here? You look like a fledgling adventurer. If you hope to prove yourself to The Dark Lady, you need to learn the ways of The Forsaken.

To the west you'll find a farm. Humans infest the land like mold on a rotting corpse. And worse yet, the Scarlet Crusade patrols nearby from their tower. Teach those scum a lesson and steal 10 of their precious pumpkins.
Once you have 10, take them to Apothecary Johaan in Brill.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Deathguard Simmer sent word that you were going to provide me with some much needed reagents. Were you able to gather 10 pumpkins yet, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have performed your bidding well, young adventurer. You are proving yourself to be quite an asset to The Dark Lady's army.
